annotations.title: Save a case to the account

description: Save a case that find_federal_case just located to the signed-in CaseMagic account, which creates its Case Passport — the persistent record of the matter — and its permanent CaseMail address. Use this after the user has confirmed which case is theirs and wants CaseMagic to keep it. Requires the connect_token from that lookup, which expires shortly afterwards.

connect_token.description: The connect_token returned by find_federal_case for the case the user confirmed.

user_role.description: The user's own role in the case. Ask them rather than guessing.

name: create_case_passport

case.description: Caption, number and court of the saved case.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: a code, a message and, where there is one, an action such as a link to give the user.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, for example CASE_NOT_FOUND or MULTIPLE_CASES_FOUND.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.
